task.concept: reinterpret logograms as abstract subwords for neural machine translation.

contribution.concept: logographic subword model

Our approach drastically reduces the size of an artificial neural network, while maintaining comparable BLEU scores as those attained with the baseline RNN and CNN seq2seq models. The smaller model size also leads to shorter training and inference time. Experiments demonstrate that in the tasks of English-Chinese/Chinese-English translation, the reduction of those aspects can be from $11\%$ to as high as $77\%$.
